assertions.subject: Neonatal alloimmune thrombocytopenic purpura
assertions.quote: Neonatal alloimmune thrombocytopenic purpura (NATP) occurs as a result of sensitization of the mother to antigens present on fetal platelets

assertions.subject: Idiopathic thrombocytopenic purpura
assertions.quote: Mothers with idiopathic thrombocytopenic purpura (maternal ITP) or with a history of ITP may have passive transfer of antiplatelet antibodies, with resultant neonatal thrombocytopenia
